locator: 28.16-20, with John 20.21-23, Matthew 16.18-19 and 18.17-18, and Lumen gentium III §§18-20 for the mandate's institutional content
goal: The bridge STMT-BRIDGE-CHRISTS-CHURCH-FOUNDED-BY-GOD is derived (CATHOLICISM-BRIDGE-DIVINE-FOUNDING-FROM-ATTESTED-MANDATE) from STMT-RESURRECTION-CONFIRMS-JESUS-MANDATE (Acts 17.31, Acts 2.22-36), STMT-GOD-CONFIRMS-ONLY-TRUTH (Dei Filius ch. 3 para. 1), STMT-MANDATE-COVERS-JESUS-FOUNDING-WITH-TEACHING and STMT-ENVOY-FOUNDING-IS-GODS-FOUNDING (John 13.20). The scope premise is in turn derived (CATHOLICISM-MANDATE-SCOPE-FROM-CATHOLIC-CHURCH-FOUNDING) from stage 6 and its instance at the Catholic Church, STMT-MANDATE-COVERS-JESUS-FOUNDING-OF-CATHOLIC-CHURCH (supported by Lumen gentium III §§18-20 and Matthew 28.18-20), so the 'which society' fork is the stage-6 fork. Next obligation, the remaining fork 'institution or message': defend the narrow premise against its recorded rival STMT-JESUS-MANDATE-COVERS-ONLY-MESSAGE (Harnack, History of Dogma I, ch. II §2, II.7) by sourced report-to-event premises that the commissions with teaching, binding and governing content (Matthew 16.18-19, 18.17-18, 28.18-20; John 20.21-23, 21.15-17) go back to Jesus; pin Matthew 16 and 18 and John 21 first. Secondary: a source analysing envoy agency beyond reception for STMT-ENVOY-FOUNDING-IS-GODS-FOUNDING (Aquinas on mission), and Romans 1.4 for attestation. Do not use Dei Filius ch. 3 para. 5's direct assertion as a premise. See docs/founding-authorization-source.md.
reason: The scope premise's universal reach over societies now rests on stage 6, already a premise of every route; its narrower remainder still carries the contested 'institution, not only message' content, and the message rival is recorded from a pinned source but not engaged by any historical premise.
